name: Reflow
install:
set -euo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y python3.12-venv python3-pip
if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then
  python3 -m venv .venv
fi
. .venv/bin/activate
# 应用导入时会在仓库根创建 gitignore 的 uploads/。setuptools 扁平发现会把它当成
# 第二个顶层包，导致之后再跑 pip install -e 失败。安装期间先挪走，装完放回。
UPLOADS_STASH=""
restore_uploads() {
  if [ -n "${UPLOADS_STASH}" ] && [ -d "${UPLOADS_STASH}" ]; then
    mv "${UPLOADS_STASH}" uploads
    UPLOADS_STASH=""
  fi
}
if [ -d uploads ]; then
  UPLOADS_STASH="$(mktemp -d /tmp/reflow-uploads.XXXXXX)"
  rmdir "${UPLOADS_STASH}"
  mv uploads "${UPLOADS_STASH}"
fi
trap restore_uploads EXIT
python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
trap - EXIT
restore_uploads
python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium
start:
set -euo pipefail
if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "reflow already listening on :8000"
  exit 0
fi
exec .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
